description: Paginated read of ingested sessions from the LLM session ledger with M17 StrEnum-typed structured filtering + ordering. Each session row carries id, source_id, external_session_id, vendor, vendor_session_label, project_path, first_event_at, last_event_at, event_count, canonical_external_session_id. Optional filters: limit clamps to [1..200] (default 50); since + until are ISO-8601 bounds on last_event_at (UTC, timezone-aware required); first_event_since + first_event_until are ISO-8601 bounds on first_event_at (use for sessions that STARTED in a specific window, e.g. 'earliest session in November 2025'); project_path is an exact-match filter; vendor is a SourceVendor StrEnum value (codex / claude_code / agent_messaging / chatgpt / claude_ai); source_kind is an IngestSourceKind StrEnum value (e.g. claude_code_local, claude_code_history, claude_code_tasks, codex_local, codex_state, codex_history, codex_goals, codex_ambient, codex_memories, agent_messaging, chatgpt_export, claude_ai_export). Ordering via order_by SessionsOrderBy StrEnum: 'last_event_at_desc' (default), 'last_event_at_asc', 'first_event_at_desc', 'first_event_at_asc'. Use first_event_at_asc + first_event_since for 'earliest in window' queries. W5.B §3.7.A canonical-only by default: the result set always filters to canonical rows (canonical_external_session_id IS NULL) so cross-source duplicates collapse automatically. Set include_siblings=true to surface both canonical and sibling rows side-by-side for operator-debug forensic audits. W5.B §3.7.A source_kind via EXISTS: source_kind=K matches the canonical row when ANY contributor in its (vendor, external_session_id) group has source_kind=K — including siblings — so cross-source conversations whose canonical's own source has a different kind still surface (Codex C2 regression fix). Pair with list_canonical_contributors to surface every contributing source for a logical conversation. Companion to get_session_timeline (per-session event drill-down), list_active_sessions (non-expired-lease filter), search_sessions (semantic+enum-filtered search), and list_tool_calls (tool-call projection drill-down).
embedding_description: List ingested LLM session ledger sessions. Returns id, source_id, external_session_id, vendor, project_path, first/last_event_at, event_count, canonical_external_session_id. Filters: limit, since/until, first_event_since/until, project_path, vendor, source_kind, order_by, include_siblings (forensic). Canonical-only by default (W5.B). Distinct from search_sessions.
